scripts.predev: test -f public/atlas/app.html || ((test -d atlas/node_modules || npm --prefix atlas ci) && npm run build:atlas)
scripts.build: npm run build:atlas && astro build && pagefind --site dist
scripts.build:atlas: npm --prefix atlas run build && rm -rf public/atlas && cp -R atlas/dist public/atlas && mv public/atlas/index.html public/atlas/app.html && npm run build:atlas-index
scripts.test: node scripts/calc.test.mjs && node scripts/recall.test.mjs && node scripts/schedule.test.mjs
